text: E ɓee heefreɓe yi'aali wonnde Meɗen ara e leydi ndin, Men ɗuytira ndi ka seraaji mari yaññugol lislaamu udditana juulɓe ɓen ton? Alla no ñaawira ko O haaji hakkunde jeyaaɓe Makko ɓen, hay e gooto wurtirtaa ñaawoore Makko nden ɗuytugol maa waylugol. Kanko seniiɗo On, ko O yacciiɗo hesboore, hiMo hasbira adiiɓe e sakkitiiɓe ñalnde wootere.
